name: 1440p RIFE (GPU) @ 90fps
description: Neural interpolation on the RTX card via TensorRT -- the same engine SVP's RIFE mode uses. Far less ghosting and block tearing on fast motion than mvtools. Built as a native VapourSynth graph (no per-frame Python), which is what kept the GPU at ~13% before. First run compiles a TensorRT engine for this frame size (minutes, once). Measure first: twixt tune <file> --backend rife
